title: Bonus-buy modes — config/bonus-buys.json
description: Purchasable direct entries into the feature tiers. Every mode is jurisdiction-gated (bonus buy is illegal in several markets), carries its own RTP, and forces feature entry via a scatter-count distribution that the math model validates. Each mode requires separate simulation results.

bonusBuys.description: All purchasable modes. May be empty when the game ships without bonus buy.

tierId.description: Canonical internal tier identifier per CONVENTIONS §4.1.

modeId.description: Kebab-case id of this buy mode, e.g. 'buy-feature', 'buy-super-feature'.

priceXBet100.description: Purchase price as a multiple of total bet, in integer hundredths of a bet (10000 = 100x bet). priceMinor = (betMinor * priceXBet100) // 100, floor, identical rule to payX100.

rtp.description: Return-to-player of this buy mode as a fraction (e.g. 0.9620). Verified by a dedicated simulation run; may legitimately differ from base-game RTP and must be disclosed where required.

forcedEntryDistribution.description: Probability of each forced triggering scatter count when this mode is purchased. Keys are scatter counts as strings ('3'..'9'); values are probabilities. The values MUST sum to exactly 1.0 (enforced by the config validator and the math model, not expressible in JSON Schema).

additionalProperties.description: Probability that the purchase lands this many scatters on the entry spin.

jurisdictionGated.description: Always true: bonus buy is only offered where config/jurisdiction-policies.json sets bonusBuyEnabled, and never in the most-restrictive default policy.

showPriceXBet.description: The price as a bet multiple is always shown before purchase.

showRtp.description: Whether this mode's RTP is shown in the buy dialog (required in some jurisdictions; the policy layer may force it on).

showMaxWin.description: Whether the game max win is shown in the buy dialog.

confirmationRequired.description: A purchase always needs an explicit second confirmation; no one-tap buys.

disclosureText.description: Optional extra disclosure copy shown in the confirmation dialog.

publicName.description: Optional themed display name of the buy option.
